page.overview:
Who is Ashlee Starling?

Ashlee Starling is a pop star that is the main antagonist in the episode "Fan-ily Feud".

Ashlee Starling is a popular singer amongst the youth of Springfield, her fans include Lisa Simpson who joined her fandom at the age of only four.

Ashlee appears as a youthful lady with yellow skin, a pointy nose and upturned eyes, she has dark blue hair worn in a bob cut and a widows peak. Being a celebrity she dresses lavishly to suit whatever occasion.

Not much is known about Ashlee. According to Lisa Simpson, she makes inspiring music for the youth, with Lisa sharing with her friends "that she encourages girls to speak truth to power and never date John Mayer". Being a public figure, Ashley puts on a friendly and positive persona, like when she invited Marge for a girls-talk, however this was only to make her drunk and get information out of her about one of her haters, Homer Simpson.
